title: 52 #### 1.7 Offences under Local and Special Laws A total number of 29,70,068 offences were reported under the Local and special Laws during 1982 against a total of 13,53,904 cognizable cases registered in 1982 under the Indian Penal Code and 25,46,399 cases under the Local and Special Laws registered in 1981. There was thus an increase of 16.6 per cent in the crime under Local and Special Laws over the year 1981 figures. As compared to 1981, the number of cases registered was less under the Arms Act, Gambling Act, Prevention of Corruption Act and Indian Railways Act. The State which registered highest number of cases under Local & Special Laws was Tamil Nadu (6,02,048) followed by Maharashtra (5,88,265), Karnataka (5,58,215) Andhra Pradesh (2,57,592), Madhya Pradesh (2,07,069) Uttar Pradesh (1,73,705), Gujarat (172,755) West Bengal (1,68,986) and Punjab (1,12,751).
